items.caption: A modern redraw of 興 in seal-script style shows the received character form discussed in the Shuowen tradition.
items.alt: Black seal-style form of 興, with a central enclosure and flanking strokes, on white.
items.selection_reason: This legible seal-style form gives a useful visual reference for the received graph. It is a modern redraw, not an excavated early inscription.

limitations.text: The exact object represented at the center of early forms remains uncertain, and this modern seal-style redraw cannot establish the appearance or chronology of oracle-bone and bronze variants.
